'''Skahtul's coalition''' was a gathering of small bands of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] under the leadership of the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] hunter [[Skahtul]] and the [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Calliose]], who allied in order to collect a huge prize on [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]'s head.
==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], there were exorbitant [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] offered for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]&mdash;one from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the other from the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate.<ref name="sotesb" /> After failing to capture Skywalker herself, Skahtul realized that Skywalker was too powerful.<ref name="DS">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref> [[Gender/Legends|She]] and her associates had little chance of capturing the powerful Jedi given his superior combat skills, so she hoped instead to overwhelm him with superior numbers. She supplemented her entourage with a number of additional hired guns to go after the reward.<ref name="sotesb" />

Promised a share from the exorbitant final reward, Skahtul joined forces with [[Calliose]] and other lone bounty hunters, as well as supplemental firepower by [[mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. While the more experiences cooperatives of the coalition were tracking down Skywalker, the main team of 15 hunters spent their time in combat training.<ref name="sotesb" />

The trackers discovered that Skywalker was going to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].<ref name="sotesb" /> The coalition succeeded in capturing Skywalker in a [[Bothan safehouse]]. While holding the Jedi captive in [[Skahtul's hideout|a fortified compound]], Skahtul hoped to play both the Empire and Black Sun against one another to drive up the bounty reward even higher.<ref name="sote" /><ref name="sote4">[[Shadows of the Empire 4|''Shadows of the Empire'' 4]]</ref> 

This backfired, as Skywalker escaped the compound with the help of his [[Force power/Legends|Jedi powers]], and was soon joined by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] who came to his rescue.<ref name="sote" /><ref name="sote4" /><ref name="sote5">[[Shadows of the Empire 5|''Shadows of the Empire'' 5]]</ref>  While the mercenaries tried to defend themselves against the two humans, Skahtul also noticed that Calliose's ruffians were firing against her mates.<ref name="partners">{{WEGCite|story=Partners No More|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> Around that time, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and his forces [[Battle of Kothlis|attacked Kothlis]], coming after Luke. As [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] invaded the hideout,<ref name="sote" /><ref name="sote5" /> Calliose's men left, and Skahtul ran after him, thinking that the cost of the operation was not worth the trouble.<ref name="partners" />

Meanwhile, Darth Vader interrogated the survivors, and learned that Black Sun wanted Luke dead.<ref name="sote" /><ref name="sote5" /><ref>{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Vader Seethes Over Luke's Escape|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC042.jpg}}</ref>
{{Stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
The coalition is mentioned in the ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' along with its background, described as being composed by various mercenaries and bounty hunters gathered around by Skahtul, including Nikto Calliose's band.<ref name="sotesb" /> However in the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|comic adaptation]], all bounty hunters responsible for Luke's capture are Barabels.<ref name="sote4" /><ref name="sote5" />

In the short story ''[[Partners No More]]'', Skahtul accuses Calliose for Luke's escape, mentioning that it was one if Calliose's men guarding Luke during his escape.<ref name="partners" /> In the comic, the guard is a Barabel under Skahtul.<ref name="sote4" />
